title: Anonymous audio-download business (Conversion Fanatics CTA study): cta copy (flat)
company: Anonymous audio-download business (Conversion Fanatics CTA study)

change.control: Give Me The Download button for a free audio download in exchange for name and email.
change.variant: Change button wording to Instant Download.

quote: Variation 1 (Instant Download) converted only slightly better than the control at 37.5%.
notes: Shared multi-arm experiment; no achieved significance or counts published. Control 37.25%, variant 37.5%; only slight change reported, no relative lift recomputed and no claim of equivalence.
